mapper.sql: select a.id, a.order_id, a.farmer_id, a.buyer_id, a.issue, a.status, a.created_at, concat('订单#', o.id, ' - ', fp.name) as order_info, fp.name as product_name, su1.username as farmer_name, su2.username as buyer_name from after_sale a left join orders o on a.order_id = o.id left join farmer_product fp on o.product_id = fp.id left join sys_user su1 on a.farmer_id = su1.id left join sys_user su2 on a.buyer_id = su2.id
mapper.select: where a.farmer_id = #{farmerId} order by a.created_at desc
where a.buyer_id = #{buyerId} order by a.created_at desc
mapper.delete:
delete from after_sale where id in
#{id}
